meta.name: Anime All day
meta.description:
Welcome to Anime All Day, where you can watch all kinds of anime from your favorite classics to today’s biggest hits. Catch up on your favorite series or jump into a new adventure with Anime All Day.

Shows: A Promise to the Heavens, Confession!, To a New Era!, Tsubasa Takes Off, The Gold Legend Revived!
Available on: Samsung TV Plus
